name: ESOI Application
description: Creates and edits specs and metrics, applies the structure's principles and runs the iterative improvement loop, so what a request needs becomes a measured specification rather than a longer prompt.
purpose: Apply ESOI to the system's own specs and metrics: an AI is the author of the specs, and a proposed edit is applied directly unless Judgment Calls decides to ask.
approach: Do the one job of the solution by the best-measured implementation.
out_of_scope: Choosing the metric for a request (Metric Translation does that) and proposing edits from feedback (Feedback Learning does that).
milestones: 1. A spec or metric edited by the loop scores no worse on its own measure afterwards (authoritative metric metric-esoi-application).
measures_of_success: A spec or metric edited by the loop scores no worse on its own measure afterwards.
inputs: A proposed change to a spec or metric.
outputs: Edited specs and metrics, and a run of the improvement loop.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.
